newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Sony invests another S$95 mln in Singapore.
newsitem.headline: Sony invests another S$95 mln in Singapore.

text.p: Sony Display Device (S) Pte Ltd (SDS), part of Sony Corp, said on Friday it was investing a further Singapore $95 million to produce 17-inch monitor picture tubes used in computers at its Singapore plant.
Sony said in a statement this would bring its total investment in the Singapore plant to S$600 million.
Sony's new investment will be in a new production line to produce picture tubes for computer use for the first time in Singapore. The new production line is targeted to start production from April.

With a projected annual production capacity of 1.5 million units, SDS's total annual production of picture tubes will be 7.5 million units. This makes SDS Sony's largest picture tube manufacturing plant.
SDS's production of 17-inch tubes will complement Sony's existing production plants at Inawaza and Mizunami in Japan and San Diego in the United States.
The Singapore-produced tubes will be supplied to Asia and some exported to the United States and Europe, the statement said.
